datasets.name: Bijie City landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The remote sensing dataset used for model training is sourced from the Bijie City landslide dataset in Guizhou Province, as reported by Ji et al. [6].

methods.name: MultiResUNet-BFDC
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation model based on the MultiResUNet framework, incorporating dilation convolutions to replace standard convolutions, a lightweight boundary-focused attention (BFA) mechanism for edge feature enhancement, and an adaptive focal and Dice loss (AFD loss) function to handle sample imbalance.
methods.source: Zhenyu Zhao, Shucheng Tan, Qinghua Zhang, and Hui Chen
methods.verbatim: To address this problem, a novel automatic landslide hazard remote sensing image identification model, MultiResUNet-BFDC, is proposed.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie City landslide dataset is referenced but not linked, and the custom MultiResUNet-BFDC code is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
